module.title: Maxwell field solvers and finite-difference stencils (Yee, Lehe, Pukhov, Cowan, custom)
module.expensive_path: update_e_field and update_b_field in fields.f90: the half-step leapfrog sweeps over every cell of E and B with the stencil coefficients set by set_field_order and set_maxwell_solver (second, fourth and sixth order; Yee, Lehe, Pukhov, Cowan and user-supplied custom coefficients read from the stencil block). In a vacuum laser-propagation deck this is the whole run.
module.rationale: The interior field advance is a closed numerical scheme: given E, B and J it advances the fields with no dependence on particles or physics packages, and its numerical dispersion (group velocity of a laser pulse) is exactly what the official maxwell_solvers and custom_stencils tests measure in every dimension.
excluded: field boundary conditions (boundary.F90: efield_bcs, bfield_bcs, CPML) -> epoch-laser-boundaries-injectors-window
current deposition and current smoothing (particles.F90, current_smooth.F90) -> epoch-particle-kinetic-core
halo exchange of the field arrays (mpi_subtype_control.f90, boundary.F90 field_mpi) -> epoch-multidimensional-parallel-core
hazards: Runs are fully deterministic (no particles); the floor is rounding only, so a 1e-15 relative perturbation of one deck value is the variant.
SDF dumps are binary64; the first block of every file carries a run date and the machine name, which the graded comparison must skip.
